title: The Moon Cheese Mission
blurb: Loki is sure the Moon is made of cheese, so the pups build a cardboard rocket and blast off to taste it.

title: The Great Pancake Tower
blurb: Lexi and Loki try to cook the tallest pancake tower in the world for Mom's birthday breakfast.

title: Pirate Pups and the Bone Treasure
blurb: A message in a bottle leads the pups on a pirate ship to a treasure chest full of golden bones.

title: The Dinosaur Who Lost His Roar
blurb: A friendly baby dinosaur cannot roar, so Lexi and Loki help him find his big voice.

title: Loki and the Giant Bubble
blurb: Loki blows a bubble so big that he floats away inside it over the town, and Lexi races to bring him down.
